query: I just arrived in Finland for a job. I don't have a personal identity code yet because Migri didn't issue one. How do I get one from DVV?
expected_answer: If you are residing legally in Finland and need a personal identity code (henkilötunnus), you can request it by submitting an online foreigner registration form to DVV. After submitting the form, you (and any accompanying family members) must visit a DVV service location in person within 1 month to verify your identity and present your original documents (such as your passport and residence permit).

query: I am an international student on a 1-year temporary (B) residence permit. Am I eligible to register a municipality of residence (kotikunta) with DVV to get local healthcare?
expected_answer: To qualify for a municipality of residence (kotikunta) on a temporary (B) residence permit, your permit must be valid for at least one year AND you must show that your studies (vocational or higher education leading to a degree) will continue in Finland for at least two years. Alternatively, you can qualify if you have already lived in Finland continuously for at least one year.

query: I got married abroad, and now my spouse and I are living in Finland. How do we register our marriage in the Finnish Population Information System?
expected_answer: To register a foreign marriage, you must present the original, official marriage certificate to DVV. The certificate must be legalised (usually with an Apostille certificate, or through legalization by a Finnish embassy if the country is not party to the Hague Convention) and translated into Finnish, Swedish, or English by an authorized translator.

query: I already have a Finnish personal identity code and just moved to a new apartment in Helsinki. Do I need to book an in-person appointment with DVV to register my new address?
expected_answer: No, you do not need to book an in-person appointment. If you already have a Finnish personal identity code, you can submit a notification of move (muuttoilmoitus) online through the joint service of DVV and Posti. You must authenticate using strong identification, such as Finnish online banking codes or a mobile certificate.

query: I just moved to Helsinki on an A-permit (continuous residence permit) for work. What are the requirements for me to register Helsinki as my municipality of residence with DVV?
expected_answer: If you hold a continuous (A) or permanent (P) residence permit, you can be granted a municipality of residence (kotikunta) if you stay in Finland legally and intend to live in the country for at least one year. You will need to apply using DVV's online foreigner registration service and visit a service location in person.

query: I arrived in Finland from Ukraine and have a temporary protection residence permit. Can I use the normal notification of move form to get a municipality of residence?
expected_answer: No. If you have a residence permit on the basis of temporary protection, you cannot apply for a municipality of residence using the standard notification of move form. Instead, you must use a dedicated online form specifically provided by DVV for Ukrainian temporary protection holders, and you must have had a valid permit for at least one year.
